about: The shell conformance suite (docs/shell-interface.md section 16; N2 slice 4, halves since N3 slice 1). Each case runs on a new graph through any shell's control dispatcher: plumcraft_editor_core::conformance is the runner and says what a step is. Points are aimed with $locate, so a case holds whatever sizes the shell measured. half: read (changes nothing of the graph after its setup) or edit; needs: what a driver must have to run it.

cases.name: a shell's measurements are what the core hits
cases.about: geometry reported (typed on the C ABI, measured by egui) is what geometry.locate, geometry.hit and the scene use

cases.name: a tap selects; Shift adds; primary takes away; empty canvas clears
cases.about: selection.set by the egui canvas's click rules, decided in the core from the hit

cases.name: a tap on a pin or a wire watches its value
cases.about: run.watch of an output, of a wired input's source, of a wire's source; a wire's tap clears the selection as empty canvas does

cases.name: a drag moves an unselected face alone and leaves the selection
cases.about: drag begin decides a move of the face under it; move changes nothing; end is one edit.move by the offset, one undo step named for what moved, which one edit.undo takes back

cases.name: a drag on a selected face moves the selection
cases.about: every selected face moves by the same offset, in one edit.move: one undo step

cases.name: a cancelled drag leaves the document as it was
cases.about: begin and move change nothing; cancel forgets the drag; an end after it is an error

cases.name: a wire dragged from an output to an input is one undo step
cases.about: the target fits while it is dragged (JSON and typed); the drop is wire.connect; one edit.undo takes it away

cases.name: a new wire dropped on nothing opens the palette for what takes it; dismissing leaves nothing
cases.about: question 8: the drop is canvas.palette with the wire; the scene's view has it; palette.items offers only kinds with a port that takes it; closing it changes nothing

cases.name: a kind chosen from a dropped wire's palette is added with the wire, as one undo step
cases.about: question 8: palette.choose adds the node where the wire was dropped and connects it (node.addWired); one edit.undo takes both away; from an input the new node's output feeds it

cases.name: two drags are two undo steps; a held arrow key is one
cases.about: decision 3: each drag is one step, named by its serial, so the next drag of the same face is another; nudges naming one key press (drag) are one step

cases.name: a drop where a wire doesn't fit is refused with the reason
cases.about: a cycle: the target says fits 0 while dragged; the drop's wire.connect is refused and the graph keeps its wires

cases.name: a wire's end picked up off an input is rerouted, or dropped
cases.about: a drag on a wired input picks its wire's end up: onto another input it is wire.reroute, onto nothing wire.disconnect

cases.name: a marquee selects what it touches
cases.about: one-shot and dragged marquees: plain replaces, Shift adds, primary takes away

cases.name: a double tap opens what it is on
cases.about: a node's parameters, a wire's value popped out, the palette on empty canvas

cases.name: a context gesture gives the menu of what it is on
cases.about: a secondary click or long press: the menu model for a node, an input, an output, a wire; the palette on empty canvas

cases.name: a collapsed group's face is its group
cases.about: a tap selects the group, a drag moves it (one edit.move, members with it), a double tap enters it

cases.name: a frame is moved by its tab and sized by its handle
cases.about: frame.move and frame.resize at a drag's end, each one undo step

cases.name: a bend point is dragged, and removed by a double tap
cases.about: wire.route with the point moved; wire.route without it

cases.name: the scene's colours are tokens alone or colours alone, and theme.get has every token
cases.about: question 13, decided 13A: a token by name, a computed colour as [r, g, b, a]

cases.name: no two items of a scene share a nid
cases.about: faces, wires, nets, frames and groups are numbered from one counter a document

cases.name: a run's state arrives in the scene
cases.about: run.start, then ui.waitRun; each face's run state reads done (or cached) in scene.get, and ui.inspect's run is idle

cases.name: a watched text value arrives as text.plain, and a scalar as scalar
cases.about: run.watch of an output runs what it needs; ui.inspect's watched names the value, its media and its viewer (text.plain, scalar), with the text's excerpt and a scalar's value inline

cases.name: a watched picture arrives as picture
cases.about: an encoded image watched: ui.inspect's watched has media image, viewer picture and its rgba8 rendition; media.get decodes it where the shell serves it

cases.name: hostile gestures and queries are refused, and the core still serves
cases.about: the hostile-input sweep for what a shell sends in N2 and N3: ui.gesture, geometry.*, scene.get, theme.get, palette.*, canvas.palette's wire, edit.move, selection.nudge

cases.name: a value typed into a row is checked, held to its range, and is one undo step
cases.about: N4 slice 2: a tap on a row that can be edited opens the core's field editor (row.edit, the scene's view.edit); row.set parses what the field holds, holds a number to its range with a note, refuses what isn't a number and changes nothing, and is one undo step (Set Value) that undo and redo take back and forth; the same value again is no step; Escape (row.edit open: false) closes it

expect./result/note: count is at most 10: set to 10

cases.name: every widget kind is set through its row, and a value that isn't one of its choices is refused
cases.about: N4 slice 2: row.set for a text, a whole and a fractional number, a switch, a choice, several choices, several lines and a colour (sent as [r, g, b] and stored in the port's #rrggbb); a choice that isn't one is refused and changes nothing

cases.name: a tap flips a switch and a drag on a number scrubs it, each one undo step
cases.about: N4 slice 2: the core decides that a tap on a switch's row is row.set to the other state, and that a drag beginning on a number's row is a scrub (kind 8 on the C ABI): its moves carry the value (a screen point at a time, at the zoom the begin gave; amount moves 0.01 a point) and change nothing; its end is one row.set; a cancelled scrub sets nothing

cases.name: the more-button opens the node's menu
cases.about: N4 slice 2: a tap on a face's more-button (the part menu the shell measured) runs no command and replies with the node's context and its menu, as a context gesture does

cases.name: a wire running right to left is routed round its faces, and hit there
cases.about: N4 slice 2 (the maintainer, N3 exit card 13): a plain wire whose input is left of its output leaves to the right, runs along a channel clear of both faces and comes into its input from the left: nine cubics (28 points) instead of the four of a wire left to right; the hit test follows that shape

cases.name: faces that overlap are shown apart, and the graph keeps its positions
cases.about: N4 slice 2 (decision 13): where two measured faces overlap (a face grown after a run, or placed over another), the scene shows the later one out of the way, below or to the right with a gap; the push is the view's: graph.get's positions, the undo step and the dirty state are as they were

cases.name: the parameters inspector lists every input, and a hidden one is set, shown and reset
cases.about: N4 slice 3: node.parameters opens the inspector (the scene's view.windows.parameters); parameters.get lists every input, shown on the face or not; node.face hides an input from the face (a view change, no undo step) and shows it again; row.set sets a hidden input, one undo step, and reset: true puts the default back; node.parameters {} closes it

cases.name: a group is made, entered and edited inside, left, ungrouped, and undone
cases.about: N4 slice 3: group.create from a selection, canvas.focus enters it (only its members are shown, the breadcrumb is in the scene's focus.path), a member renamed in place inside it (name.edit, name.set), the group renamed in place, left (canvas.focus null), collapsed and expanded, ungrouped, and Ungroup undone

cases.name: a frame is made round a selection, renamed in place, resized, and grows with a member pushed out of another's way
cases.about: N4 slice 3: frame.add round the selection, name.edit on its tab and name.set (one undo step), frame.resize; two faces placed one over the other are shown apart (12.11), and the frame that holds them is shown grown to hold the one pushed, while the graph keeps its size

cases.name: a net is made, joined, renamed in place and left
cases.about: N4 slice 3: wire.label draws a wire as a net (its driver's tag says how many inputs it feeds), net.connect joins another input to it, name.edit and name.set rename it in place, wire.unlabel takes one input back out as a wire, and undo puts it back; every step but the rename's opening is one undo step

cases.name: a value popped out is a window of the core's: brought forward, viewed and closed
cases.about: N4 slice 3 (the Watched column gone, the maintainer: 'Eliminate the side column in favor of just the popout window'): a double tap on an output pin pops its value out (view.popout), the scene's view.windows lists it with its title; asking again brings it forward (raised); popout.get reads its value and the viewer's state, which viewer.text and viewer.zoom change; view.close closes it

cases.name: Select mode and Share are the core's commands, and the toolbar's state is the core's
cases.about: N4 slice 3 (golden rule 4, the maintainer: 'No exceptions to the rule'): canvas.selectMode toggles the core's Select mode (the scene's view.select, View › Select Mode's check); graph.share is File › Share…, disabled with the reason until the graph has a file; menu.get's toolbar context gives every toolbar button with its label, icon, enabled state and check from the core

want./reason: save the graph first: Share sends its file

cases.name: settings are the core's: a setting set is read back, kept, and reset
cases.about: N4 slice 4: settings.get is the model a shell renders (sections, items, kinds, values, the command each is set through); view.animationSpeed and theme.setToken change it, it is read back, and on a shell whose core keeps a preferences file (prefs) what that file holds now has it (what a reopen reads); then both are reset

cases.name: a theme chosen is the scene's, and Match the System is one of the built-in themes
cases.about: N4 slice 4: view.theme changes the theme every scene is built in; theme.get says which and has every token the scene names; system shows Paper or Dusk by the system's appearance; back to Paper, then Match the System again (the default), so a shell's kept preferences are left as they were

cases.name: an autosaved document saves itself once a change settles, and a failure is reported
cases.about: N4 slice 4 (contract 4.4): document.autosave turns autosave on with a file in the core's scratch folder; a frame added is on disk once it settles (the file read back matches the graph, the document clean); a file that can't be written is reported failed with its reason and the document stays dirty; then off

cases.name: the control port asks for its token, whatever address it listens on
cases.about: N4 slice 4: a driver over the control port (on a device, the local network's) opens a second connection and is refused with a wrong token, and a request sent before authenticating is refused too; the connection the suite runs on authenticated with the pre-shared token

cases.name: a number shows the same text everywhere: an INT whole, a FLOAT at the decimals its port gives
cases.about: N4 slice 4 (the maintainer: "precision should be set to something sensible"): a FLOAT set to a slider's 0.30000000000000004 shows 0.30 (its port's two decimals, not the float's noise) in the parameters inspector and on the face, and an INT set to 6.7 is 7 and shows 7, never decimals; the scene and parameters.get carry the text so every shell shows the same
